items.title: 30.5 Kisi molecule ka 1H NMR spectrum predict karna (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of predicting a 1H NMR spectrum (PDF 210).

blocks.text: Chemical environments, chemical shifts aur batne ke zariye kisi molecule ka 1H NMR spectrum us ki banawat se predict kiya ja sakta hai.

items: Mukhtalif proton environments pehchanein: environments ki tadaad mutawaqqa peaks ki tadaad hai.
Barabar protons ke har set ki chemical shift Table 30.1 se andaza karein; electronegative atoms ke qareeb protons ki shift zyada, alkyl groups walon ki kam.
Har peak ka batne ka namoona n + 1 rule se batayein.
Har environment ke hydrogen atoms ki tadaad se peaks ke nisbati areas tay karein.

blocks.title: Misal 30.1: chloroethane, CH3CH2Cl
blocks.text: Do environments, is liye do peaks. CH2 electronegative Cl se jura hai, is liye us ki shift zyada (3.0-4.5 ppm); CH3 ki kam (0.5-1.5 ppm). CH3 CH2 ke 2 H se triplet mein bat'ta; CH2 CH3 ke 3 H se quartet mein. CH3 aur CH2 ke peak areas 3:2 hain.

blocks.prompt: Propan-2-ol, (CH3)2CHOH, ke liye batayein (a) peaks ki tadaad, (b) proton ki qism aur chemical shift, (c) nisbati peak areas, (d) batne ka namoona.
blocks.explanation: (a) Teen. (b) Do CH3 groups (alkyl, 0.5-1.5 ppm); O ke saath CH (3.0-4.5 ppm); OH (0.5-6.0 ppm). (c) 6:1:1. (d) CH3: doublet (1 parosi); CH: saat sub-peaks (6 parosi; OH aam taur par nahi baant'ta); OH: singlet.

items: Predict: environments (peaks), shifts (Table 30.1), batna (n + 1), areas (H ki tadaad).
Chloroethane: CH3 triplet 0.5-1.5, CH2 quartet 3.0-4.5, areas 3:2.
